posts.zh:
dsh-music-player 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 DSH Web 界面播放本地音乐：Host 扫描本地音乐目录（默认 ~/Music）并以 HTTP 流式播放，提供正在播放条（上一首/播放/停止、循环模式、音量、实时频谱）与可拖动的播放列表面板，并注册 `music_play` 模型工具让 agent 直接播放。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-82e19a0c185d355ad451.html
posts.en:
dsh-music-player is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Play your own local music in the DSH web UI: the host scans a local folder (default ~/Music) and streams it over HTTP, with a now-playing bar (prev/play/stop, loop modes, volume, live spectrum) and a draggable playlist panel, plus a model-invokable `music_play` tool.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-82e19a0c185d355ad451.html
